events.event: Prabowo conferred the national hero title on 19 posthumous figures at Istana Negara under Presidential Decree No. 93/TK/2026, including ex-Kapolri Hoegeng, Ali Sadikin, M. Jusuf and his own grandfather Margono Djojohadikusumo.
events.why_it_matters: Margono's title, a relative of the president, plus Hoegeng's during a police-wiretap row, makes the list a talking point.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC, Kompas, Liputan6, Antara, Okezone, IDN Times, TVOne (search results 10 Nov)

events.event: Jakarta police recorded 74 public-aspiration demonstrations on Heroes' Day, concentrated at the DPR/MPR building, Bundaran HI, Dukuh Atas and Monas, with civil society and student groups.
events.key_numbers: 74 aksi (83 community activities) · 47 in Central Jakarta · about 2,500-2,700 protesters expected per police notifications · no firearms allowed for officers
events.why_it_matters: Road closures and crowds around the DPR affected commuters while the Gibran and wiretapping disputes are live.
events.spreading_evidence: Reported by CNN Indonesia, Kompas, Detik, Viva, IDN Times, Media Indonesia

events.event: Kemenhaj opened final payment (pelunasan Bipih) for 2027 regular hajj, with stage 1 from 10 Nov to 10 Dec 2026 and stage 2 from 16 to 31 Dec if quota remains.
events.key_numbers: Bipih Rp43.7 juta (Aceh) to Rp58.1 juta (Surabaya) · Jakarta Rp53.5 juta · quota 203,320 (191,419 current-year pilgrims, 10,166 elderly priority) · BPKH subsidy avg Rp43.8 juta per pilgrim · stage 1 10 Nov-10 Dec · stage 2 16-31 Dec
events.why_it_matters: Hundreds of thousands of waiting pilgrims must pay a figure that depends on their departure city, within one month.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC, CNN Indonesia, Tribun, Himpuh and many regional outlets

events.event: BNPB reported flood-dominated hydrometeorological disasters across Indonesia in 2026 through 10 Nov, with 620 floods, 363 extreme-weather events, 114 landslides and 14 high-wave events.
events.key_numbers: 620 floods · 363 extreme weather · 114 landslides · 14 abrasion/high waves · 70 deaths and 49 injured in floods · more than 4,900 homes damaged by floods
events.why_it_matters: Gives the scale behind the Aceh and Sumatra flood news as the rainy season begins.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara BNPB tag; Menkes remark that RI is in the world's top 3 for disasters was on CNN Indonesia nasional 9 Nov (not opened)

events.event: Pidie Jaya in Aceh is under a 14-day disaster emergency (4-17 Nov) after river floods hit four sub-districts, and flash floods and landslides in Aceh Tengah collapsed two emergency bridges.
events.key_numbers: Bupati Decree 373/2026 · 4-17 Nov emergency · 4 sub-districts flooded in Pidie Jaya · 10 families evacuated and about 10 houses affected (as of 9 Nov) · 2 emergency bridges collapsed and 5 villages affected in Aceh Tengah · CNN headline: 21 villages hit by follow-up flood in Pidie Jaya (not opened)
events.why_it_matters: It is the same region hit by the late-2025 Sumatra disasters, and CNN notes it is one year into recovery.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional list (21 desa Pidie Jaya; setahun pascabencana Sumatra); Antara

events.event: BNPB reported karhutla hotspots and burned area as of 8 Nov, concentrated in Central Kalimantan.
events.key_numbers: 1,051 hotspots · 864 fire spots · 4,473 ha burned in six priority provinces (4,486 ha with Sulawesi) · Central Kalimantan 907 hotspots and 3,904 ha · South Kalimantan 59 and 345 ha · Jambi 44 and 105 ha · South Sumatra 40 and 98 ha
events.why_it_matters: Fires continue into November while floods hit Sumatra, so the same country has both haze and flood emergencies.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets carry BNPB figures; no most-read placement seen

events.event: CNN Indonesia reported the crew of a karhutla water-bombing helicopter that crashed into the Barito River was buried in Tangerang.
events.why_it_matters: Shows the human cost of firefighting this season.

events.event: TurnBackHoax (Mafindo) rated false a Facebook post claiming party elites urged Prabowo to replace VP Gibran with Sufmi Dasco Ahmad amid the wiretapping case; Dasco denied it on X.
events.key_numbers: Fact-check dated 10 Nov 2026 · Dasco denial 4 Nov 2026 · post had only 14 reactions and 20 comments
events.why_it_matters: Fake succession claims are circulating alongside real DPR talk of a hak menyatakan pendapat on Gibran.
events.spreading_evidence: Low engagement on the original post; hoax-tracker page only
